name: @grid-authority/geo-build
description: Manual geometry pipeline. Run by hand; its output is committed.

scripts.simplify: mapshaper geo/src/zones.raw.geojson -simplify 4% keep-shapes -clean -o precision=0.0001 format=geojson geo/src/zones.simplified.geojson
scripts.simplify-context: mapshaper geo/src/context.raw.geojson -simplify 10% keep-shapes -filter-islands min-area=2000km2 -clean -o precision=0.001 format=geojson geo/context.geojson
